findings.title: WireGuard/lab secret ignore patterns in .gitignore are corrupted
evidence: .gitignore:20 pattern is 'lab-audit- *.conf' (space breaks the match for lab-audit-*.conf)
.gitignore:18 'deterministic-out/ # Lab audit ...' is not a valid ignore pattern (git ignores inline comments)
findings.impact: Generated WireGuard client configs (private keys) and scratch scan output can be committed because the ignore rules do not match.
findings.recommendation: Restore the intended patterns ('*.swp', 'lab-audit-*.conf', '*.wgkey', 'deterministic-out/') and add a CI check that `git check-ignore` matches a sample secret file.

report: Reviewed secret material handling: `/etc/lab-api/env` (0600), WireGuard client keys, and the lab token lifecycle. No secret values printed.
